text:
anya: Ran a quick nsys snapshot on the ded pool (seq=4096, batch=8). KV hitrate dropped ~50% mid-run and HBM BW spiked to ~1.2 TB/s for ~8-12s. Timeline attached.

devin: paste the nsys summary and command?

anya: ran with:
```
nsys profile --output=kv-hbw-run1 --trace=cuda,osrt --sample=none \
  --duration=300 ./run_infer --model rwt-13b --seq 4096 --workload 128
```

perf-bot: nsys report:
- GPU mem bw (aggregate): avg 420 GB/s, peak 1.2 TB/s
- Long bursts on memcpy/ivalcpy, copy engine utilization high
- nvtx ranges show 'kv_load' spikes aligning with peaks

sam: looked at kernel selection around the spike: selector switched to fp16_gemm_v2 and fp16_unified_kv when seq > 2048. Those kernels do wider loads and trigger more page requests on our PMem/KV layout.

maria: perfetto slice shows DMA waves in bursts, about 64-128 KB per DMA op. That pattern + eviction means HBM gets hammered in short windows.

anya: here's the nvprof counters for the worst 10s:
```
DRAM_Read_Throughput: 1.12 TB/s
DRAM_Write_Throughput: 120 GB/s
L2_Hit_Rate: 0.62 -> drops to 0.34 during spike
SM_Stall: +18%
```

devin: Hm L2 drop suggests working set spilled past L2 and forced HBM roundtrips. Could be KV cache thrash when large sequence prefixes cause many distinct KV pages.

sam: confirming: the KV slab has 256B entries but our prefetch groups are coalesced into 4KB page-sized IOs. Long sequences produce many unique page indices; microburst prefetch + eviction = readstorm.

maria: hypothesis: kernel selector favors larger fused kernels for seq>2048 which increase simultaneous KV lookups per threadblock -> wider memory fanout -> bursts.

anya: repro plan: 1) run isolated microbench with varying seqlen and controlled KV hitrate; 2) add instrumentation to measure unique KV page refs per 1s window; 3) try forcing smaller kernel via env var KERNEL_FORCE=fp16_small and re-run.

devin: quick mitigations: cap microbatch token window to 1024, throttle prefetch budget, and bind kernel selector to prefer smaller-gemm for long-seq workloads. Patch suggestion:
```
batcher:
  max_microbatch_tokens: 1024
  kv_prefetch_budget: 32
kernel_selector:
  force_pref_small_for_seq_gt: 2048
```

sam: i'll instrument unique page counter and rerun tonight on ded-pt2. Will post traces.

perf-bot: noted: new job queued kv-repro-2764, will upload nsys + perfetto tarball when complete.

anya: thanks — if we confirm it's kernel-driven, next step is small kernel backoff and a heuristic that detects rising unique-page-rate to auto-throttle prefetch.

maria: +1. Also add alert in Console for sudden L2 hit-rate drops tied to HBM spikes so SRE can auto-fallback to smaller kernels.

devin: ok assigning follow-ups: sam (repro + instrumentation), anya (patch proposal for batcher + selector), maria (alert dashboard). I'll open tracking issue.
